translations.web: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.
translations.bsb: Then a flood of forces will be swept away before him and destroyed, along with a prince of the covenant.
translations.kjv: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
translations.asv: And the overwhelming forces shall be overwhelmed from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
